releases.name: 30th Celebration: Battle Deck (Espeon ex & Umbreon ex)
releases.products: Battle Deck (Espeon ex), Battle Deck (Umbreon ex)

releases.name: Ascended Heroes: Focused Fighters Premium Collection
releases.products: Focused Fighters Premium Collection (14 Ascended Heroes packs, Mega Hawlucha ex, Team Rocket's Mewtwo ex, N's Reshiram & Zekrom promos)
releases.note: In-store and embargo release date is 30 October 2026. Originally a US Sam's Club exclusive (21 July 2026). Online sold out already at Kmart (bought out by bots), EB Games, Toymate and JB Hi-Fi (pre-sold out, no release-day stock), with Treasure Collectables selling at scalper prices. Big W, Target and others have not sold online yet and may still do so before release day, plus in-store allocation. Expected Australian retail price is $140 to $199.

releases.name: 30th Celebration: 5 Booster Tin (Sylveon ex / Greninja ex)
releases.products: 5 Booster Tin (Sylveon ex / Greninja ex, 5-pack version)
releases.note: EB Games lists the 5 Booster Tin for 6 November 2026, the original Wave 4 date. It is the only Wave 4 product still on that date. This is the 5-pack version of the Sylveon ex / Greninja ex tin sold by some retailers; other retailers sell the 4-pack version on 4 December (Wave 5).

releases.name: Delta Reign
releases.products: Booster Box (36 packs), Elite Trainer Box, Booster Bundle (6 packs), Three Booster Blister, Sleeved Booster Packs, Checklane Blister, 9-Pocket Portfolio, 4-Pocket Portfolio
releases.note: Build and Battle Box follows on 20 November 2026.

releases.name: 30th Celebration: Ultra-Premium Collections (Day & Night)
releases.note: Delayed from 6 November. Toymate told pre-order customers 13 November 2026 (supplier delay in production and supply), and EB Games lists the same date. Other retailers are expected to reflect the new date, likely a supplier or distributor delay. Pre-order update, 23 September 2026: Kmart listed the Ultra-Premium Collections online, but bot traffic overwhelmed the listing and no genuine customer using a standard browser could complete a purchase. BigW and Target are still to open online pre-orders. Pokemon Center AU has not made this release available to Australian customers at all.

releases.name: 30th Celebration: Ditto Premium Collection & Figure Collection (Mew & Mewtwo)
releases.products: Ditto Premium Collection, Figure Collection (Mew & Mewtwo)
releases.note: Delayed from 6 November. Toymate told pre-order customers: "Our supplier has informed us of an unexpected delay with production and the supply of stock to Toymate. As a result, the release date has now been moved to 20-Nov-26." EB Games also lists both products for 20 November 2026. Expect other retailers to follow.

releases.name: 30th Celebration: Sylveon ex Tin & Greninja ex Tin
releases.products: Sylveon ex Tin, Greninja ex Tin (4-pack version at some retailers), Mega Forces Tin (listed by EB Games)
releases.note: Some retailers sell the 5-pack version of these tins from 6 November (see Wave 4); this December date is the 4-pack version. EB Games also lists a Mega Forces Tin for 4 December. The Binder Collection was also originally slated for this wave, but Big W shipped it early in Australia alongside the Wave 1 launch on 16 September - it is not part of this December release here.
